Handcrafted Holiday Market

  • Saturday, December 19, 2026
  • 10:00 AM 5:00 PM 10:00 17:00
  • NC State Fairgrounds - Expo Center (map)
  • Google Calendar ICS

We are SO excited for our biggest Holiday Market yet at the NC State Fairgrounds. Join us on Saturday and Sunday for shopping from over 200 local Makers, enjoy live music, food trucks, and meet Santa!

Event Times:
Saturday, December 20, 10:00am-5:00pm
Sunday, December 21, 10:00am-3:00pm

General Admission is $5 ahead of time or $7 at the door+ Children 16 and under are free to attend. Admission grants you access for both days.

The NC State Fairgrounds has tons of FREE parking. It's your LAST chance to shop local before the Holidays!
